class Report {
  constructor(public title: string) {}
}
console.log(new Report("monthly").title);

class Algorithm {
  constructor(public x: number) {}
}
function f(a: Algorithm) {
  return a.x;
}
console.log(f(new Algorithm(2)));

class Keyframe {
  position = 1;
}
const k: Keyframe = new Keyframe();
console.log(k.position);

interface Transformer {
  label: string;
}
interface AbortController {
  note: string;
}
interface Storage {
  size: number;
}
interface ShareData {
  tag: string;
}
class ShareData {}
const s = new ShareData();
console.log(s.tag);

const Body = "body as a value";
console.log(Body);

function read(b: Request) {
  return b.url;
}
console.log(typeof read);
